anti_generic_signature_read: Exceptionally tall neck, large calm face and chunky mechanical feet distinguish the character. The repaired signature connects hold and wind, set down, and release.
blind_action_read: Initial blind sequence showed whole-body translation with foot knob rotation and no articulated stride. The repaired sequence shows rotation while stationary, slight lowering, then rotation with forward translation.
blind_form_read: A volumetric rounded cuboid head and thick mechanical body with faceted rounded edges, narrow segmented neck, squat hips and chunky feet.
blind_held_read: A single long-necked mechanical bird/dinosaur-like robot with a large head, ribbed neck, two legs and broad wheeled feet; it holds no object.
blind_relationship_read: The head sits above a long neck, hips connect to two bent legs, and broad feet carry the visible rolling elements.
blind_subjects_read: One mechanical creature; no second subject or held accessory.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Large rounded cuboid head, long ribbed neck, squat hips, two bent legs and broad mechanical feet; after reveal the reference comparison confirmed a recognizable printable simplification.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: One upright robot microduck resembling the supplied image.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Circular side eye, horizontal mouth and large calm head were read blindly; revealed comparison recognized grey rim, purple eye, small oval sensor and yellow bill.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Retain the reference face and characteristic proportions.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Repaired sequence shows stationary-body knob rotation, lowering and rotation with forward translation; signature captions identify winding, placement and release.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: A knob winds the toy so it can move.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: One rigid mechanical character rolls; no stride, held item or other subject is depicted.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Do not require unrequested walking, electronics, held objects or a second subject.

largest_risk: Physical propulsion, traction, cord behavior and bonded retention remain untested. Dark lighting and left-foot rendering noise are nonblocking presentation polish.
resolution: Round 1 accepted form and desirability but rejected the rolling-only presentation. The single focused repair added exact winding, lowering and release states plus a labeled signature. The same critic inspected all 20 decoded frames and accepted the combined visual and simulated motion evidence in round 2. No physical performance is claimed. After localized manufacturing repairs, a separate independent native reviewer <HOME>/manufacturing_amendment inspected the updated iso, signature and all 20 decoded frames and found no new visual blockers or changed conclusions. This is a non-blind technical amendment, not a third creative round; the original critic did not see these amended bytes. Exact evidence and preserved history are in review/manufacturing-amendment.md and review/visual-history.md.
